method.svg: Parse actual XML CUT paths; independently integrate closed M/L/Z polygon areas. Seven role groups per part, separate hole CUT loop, both A4 units and calibration marker verified.

method.hashes: Re-read and SHA256 all 23 paths in run03/results.json.files_sha256; each matches. No original run files were modified.

capture_limitation: QScreen.grabWindow(dialog.winId) returned a black 700x570 assembly-dialog-desktop image; it is preserved and is not visual evidence of dialog labels. The actual dialog OpenGL framebuffer clearly shows the connected planes and trim. Main-window desktop captures show the authoring work, linked selection, both checked locks, true hole and reopened model. Modal title/90-degree input/enabled OK/click are recorded actual QWidget interactions, not inferred from the black image.
native_file_dialogs: Three run03 own-PID Win32 records have native_seen=true and accepted=true: Save, Open, directory picker. Two real QMessageBox instances were accepted by clicking their actual OK buttons.
acceptance_scope: Technical PC006A own-polygon/trim/basic-edge-connection/tab/layout/save-reopen/vector-export traversal. Does not certify whole model A, interior connections, curved B/C/D, novice usability or P3.
